steps.text: Talk to Denulth in Burthorpe. You can get there with the Burthorpe minigame teleport or a games necklace.
choices: Do you have any quests for me?

steps.text: Ask Eohric, upstairs in Burthorpe castle, about the guard that was on duty last night.
Ask Eohric, upstairs in Burthorpe castle, about the guard that was on duty last night.
choices: I'm looking for the guard that was on last night.

steps.text: Talk to Harold, upstairs in the bar in Burthorpe.

Talk to Harold, upstairs in the bar in Burthorpe.
choices: You're the guard that was on duty last night?

Talk to Eohric.

Talk to Harold.
Talk to Harold.
Talk to Harold.
Talk to Harold to give him a Blurberry Special.

steps.text: Gamble with Harold (101 coins to immediately bankrupt him).
Read the IOU, and then keep the Combination for the end of the quest.

Go back to Burthorpe castle, and place the coloured stone balls in the correct spots on the mechanism.
Open the quest's journal to sync your current quest state.
Enter the cave north west of Burthorpe.
Talk to Saba.
choices: Do you know of another way up Death Plateau?

steps.text: Leave Saba's cave.
Go northwest of Burthorpe, then south at the fork, and talk to Tenzing.
choices: OK, I'll get those for you.

steps.text: Ask Denulth about Dunstan's son.
Talk to Dunstan at the anvil in Burthorpe, then talk to Denulth, where you started the quest.
Talk to Dunstan to exchange the climbing boots for spiked boots.
Bring the spiked boots, along with (unnoted) 10 bread and 10 trout to Tenzing.
Exit Tenzing's house into the backyard THROUGH THE NORTH DOOR and OVER THE STILE. Continue north past the Death Plateau warning, and around to the east until you stop and say you've gone far enough.
Go back and talk to Denulth, giving him the secret map and Combination.

rewards: The ability to purchase and equip Climbing Boots.
